explanation: The value is high at D1 and GO and near zero at D2. At D1 it is about 10 after an unrewarded trial and 7-8 after a rewarded one; at GO it is about 9 when the agent chooses a1 and 7 when it chooses a2 (5-6 for a2 right after a loss); at D2 it is 0 during a2 runs, 1 after a common transition and 2-3 after a rare one (reaching S2 from a1) during a1 runs.
